title: General Contractors — Why Multi-Service Companies See Territory Value Differently
content:
###  **One Conversation, Multiple Openings** 

A single-trade roofing company gets one conversation topic with a homeowner. A general contractor offering roofing, remodeling, and exterior work gets several — which changes the math on what a single neighborhood conversation is worth. 

###  **Why This Matters for Territory Presence** 

When a Territory Representative has a conversation with a homeowner, a general contractor's broader service line means more potential entry points into that relationship, even if the immediate need is narrow. 

### **The Long Game** 

A homeowner who remembers your name for a gutter repair today may call for a full remodel two years from now. General contractors are uniquely positioned to benefit from that longer relationship arc. 

###  **Worth Exploring** 

If your company offers more than one service line, it is worth understanding how territory presence could work across your full range rather than a single category.
